issues.description: The exercise asks students to "Implementieren Sie eine Funktion namens `print_newline`" (problem_statement.md lines 21-22), but the reference solution defines a label named `print_nl` (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm line 6). The template repository (template_repository/helloWorld.asm lines 5-8) does not include a `print_newline` stub. This name mismatch between the specification and the solution will confuse students: they may implement or look for `print_newline` while the reference uses `print_nl`, making it difficult to map the required symbol to the solution and to reuse the reference implementation directly.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the function/label name consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: rename the solution label `print_nl` to `print_newline` (update any references) and optionally add a small `print_newline` stub in the template so students have the expected symbol to implement. Alternatively, if `print_nl` is preferred, update the problem statement to request `print_nl` and add the same name to the template.
